name: agent-desktop
description: Control macOS, Windows and Linux desktop apps from AI agents through the OS accessibility tree, with a JSON CLI, MCP server and C library for computer-use builders.

skills.name: Accessibility Snapshot
skills.description: Reads a desktop app's accessibility tree and returns it as JSON, with a ref for every element the agent can act on.

skills.name: Act on Elements
skills.description: Clicks, types, selects, toggles and scrolls UI elements by ref, headless by default without moving the pointer.

skills.name: Apps and Windows
skills.description: Launches and closes apps, lists windows and displays, and focuses, resizes, moves, minimizes or maximizes windows.

skills.name: Clipboard and Notifications
skills.description: Reads, sets and clears the clipboard, and lists, dismisses or triggers actions on desktop notifications.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: Serves every agent-desktop command as an MCP tool over stdio and returns each command's JSON envelope.
